title: H 3003 (119th General Assembly): Voter ID
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) S.C. Code 7-13-710(A) as amended by SECTION 5
(quote) When a person presents himself to vote, he shall produce a valid and current: (1) South Carolina driver's license; or (2) other form of identification containing a photograph issued by the Department of Motor Vehicles; or (3) passport; or (4) military identification containing a photograph issued by the federal government; or (5) South Carolina voter registration card containing a photograph of the voter pursuant to Section 7-5-675.
(section) 7-13-710(B)
(quote) One of the managers also shall compare the photograph contained on the required identification with the person presenting himself to vote. The manager shall verify that the photograph is that of the person seeking to vote.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) 7-13-710(C)(1)
(quote) If the elector cannot produce the identification as required in subsection (A), he may cast a provisional ballot that is counted only if the elector brings a valid and current photo identification to the county board of registration and elections before certification of the election by the county board of canvassers.
(section) 7-13-710(D)(1)(a)
(quote) If an elector does not produce a valid and current photograph identification due to a religious objection to being photographed, he may complete an affidavit under penalty of perjury at the polling place ... Upon completion of the affidavit, the elector may cast a provisional ballot.
(section) 7-13-710(D)(1)(b)
(quote) If an elector does not produce a valid and current photograph identification because the elector suffers from a reasonable impediment that prevents the elector from obtaining photograph identification, he may complete an affidavit under the penalty of perjury at the polling place ... The elector also shall list the impediment, unless otherwise prohibited by state or federal law.
(section) 7-13-710(D)(2)
(quote) If the county board of registration and elections determines that the voter was challenged only for the inability to provide proof of identification and the required affidavit is submitted, the county board of registration and elections shall find that the provisional ballot is valid unless the board has grounds to believe the affidavit is false.
(section) 56-1-3350(B)(2) (SECTION 6)
(quote) An identification card must be free to a person aged seventeen years or older.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) 7-5-675 (SECTION 4)
(quote) The State Elections Commission shall implement a system in order to issue voter registration cards with a photograph of the elector. This voter registration card may be used for voting purposes only.
(section) 7-13-710(E)
(quote) The purpose of the identification required pursuant to subsection (A) is to confirm the person presenting himself to vote is the elector on the poll list. Any address listed on the identification is not determinative of an elector's domicile for the purpose of voting.
(section) SECTION 8
(quote) The State Election Commission is directed to create a list containing all registered voters of South Carolina who are otherwise qualified to vote but do not have a South Carolina driver's license or other form of identification containing a photograph issued by the Department of Motor Vehicles as of December 1, 2011.
(section) SECTION 11
(quote) SECTION 4 takes effect upon preclearance approval by the United States Department of Justice or approval by a declaratory judgment issued by the United States District Court for the District of Columbia, whichever occurs first.
(other) SECTION 1 (7-1-25(D)): lists eleven factors to weigh when deciding where a voter is domiciled (tax-return address, real estate, mailing address, licence address, and so on).
(other) SECTION 2 (7-5-125): a voter who loses or defaces the registration notice may get a duplicate from the county board in person, by phone or by mail.
(other) SECTION 3 (7-5-230): when residence or domicile is challenged, the board must apply the 7-1-25(D) factors (replaces the old 'may consider' list); adds a right of appeal to the court of common pleas.
(other) SECTION 4 (7-5-675): State Election Commission to build a system issuing photo voter registration cards; effective only on federal preclearance and funding (SECTION 11).
(other) SECTION 6 (56-1-3350): special (non-driver) ID card available from age five; fee $5 only for ages five to sixteen; free at seventeen and older; renewal fee and indigent-waiver language struck; card marked for under-21; fees go to the non-federal-aid highway fund.
(other) SECTION 7: State Election Commission must run a voter education program (notices at county offices and websites, poll-manager training, seminars, newspaper ads by Dec. 15, 2011, a notice by Dec. 1, 2011 to every voter with no SC driver's licence or ID card).
(other) SECTION 9: one-subject finding. SECTION 10: everything but SECTION 4 takes effect on the Governor's approval.
(other) version: 2010-12-07_Introduced (prefiled): ID list of five (driver's licence, DMV photo ID, passport, military photo ID, photo voter registration card); provisional ballot cured by bringing photo ID; religious-objection and reasonable-impediment affidavits; free ID at 17+; ALSO touches absentee request/return procedure (7-15-330, 7-15-385; no ID rule there), repeals 7-15-470, voter list as of Jan. 1, 2013; no citizenship text.
(other) version: 2011-01-19_Introduced (House Judiciary report, with amendment): same ID text in slots a-b; amendment makes the photo registration card 'for voting purposes only', ties fee return to card rollout, changes ad timing, adds Help America Vote Act accommodation item; ID card age lowered to five; no citizenship text.
(other) version: 2011-01-26_Introduced (as amended on the House floor and passed): ID list and provisional/affidavit text unchanged from 01-19; list date moved to Dec. 1, 2011; adds poll-watcher seating section 7-13-862; floor amendment texts are not saved separately.
(other) version: 2011-02-02_Introduced (Senate Judiciary report striking the bill and inserting a new text, 'South Carolina Election Reform Act'; the saved file also reprints the House-passed bill after it): ID list grows to six items (adds employee ID card with photo issued by the federal government, this State or a county or municipality); 'valid and current' becomes 'valid and unaltered'; adds a deeming sentence; adds early voting (15 days) and absentee-centre changes; no ID rule for absentee ballots.
(other) version: 2011-02-03_Introduced: scrivener correction of 02-02 (a comma added in item (5)); same substance.
(other) version: 2011-02-23_Introduced (Senate committee amendment as amended and adopted): ID list still six items; early voting shortened to 11 days; ADDS 7-13-715 exempting electors born on or before Jan. 1, 1947 from the ID rule (they show a DMV licence/photo ID or the signed registration notice); non-severability clauses.
(other) version: 2011-02-24_Introduced: scrivener correction (title line); same ID text.
(other) version: 2011-02-25_Introduced: scrivener correction to an effective-date clause (drops a reference to SECTION 13); same ID text.
(other) version: 2011-04-06_Introduced (House Amendment No. 1A, 'not printed'): drops the employee ID card and the age-based exemption and early voting; ID list back to five items and 'valid and current'; keeps provisional ballot and both affidavits; adds birth-record data sharing for ID cards (44-63-65) and poll-watcher seating; photo-card section effective July 1, 2012.
(other) version: 2011-05-11_Introduced (conference report, enrolled as Act 27): five-item ID list; provisional ballot plus religious-objection and reasonable-impediment affidavits; free ID at 17+; ADDS domicile factors (7-1-25(D), 7-5-230) and the 7-13-710(E) purpose sentence and the no-photo-ID voter list; drops 44-63-65, poll-watcher seating, early voting and the age exemption.
(other) note: Final text = conference report (tag 2011-05-11_Introduced), ratified R 54, Act No. 27 of 2011 (summary page). No version carries an ID rule for absentee ballots or any proof-of-citizenship rule (slots c and d: not stated); the only 'citizen' hits are the UOCAVA reference and the 'overseas citizens' absentee category. House floor amendments (Nos. 1, 2, 4, 5, 8, 18, 26, 27) and Senate amendments (P1, P3, P4, P7, P482, P8, P9, P11, P15, P14b) are not saved as separate text. The votes list contains duplicate entries for the same roll calls (same KEY on the official page) from two collections: e.g. KEY 1932 'Continue' appears as 43-63 and 43-76, KEY 1934 passage as 74-33 and 74-45, KEY 1933, 1935, 2010-2168 and 2453-2831 likewise. The 'actions' list gives 'Roll call Yeas-74 Nays-45' for House passage, matching the second copy of each; both copies are kept unchanged and each is labelled below. The 7-13-710 amendment text matches the S.C. Code 7-13-710 photo-ID law (Act 27 of 2011) itself.
